items.title: The theory of free Steiner triple systems is stable
items.author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
items.work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled proposition at source lines 1033-1034: the theory of free Steiner triple systems is stable. The proof (source lines 1035-1037) is a counting argument, and its substance is the choice of invariant: one has to know that a one-type over a model is determined by the partial isomorphism type of a countable tuple, which is exactly the content of the preceding elementarity results, and only then does the bound by the cardinality raised to omega become immediate. The statement records stability and neither the invariant nor the bounding step.
